subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should configured-but-unresolved local gateway credentials stop status commands before probing, or remain diagnostic context while the shipped reachability probe runs?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but it intentionally removes a shipped fallback across three status surfaces; maintainer intent is required to choose that compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve Probe Behavior
options.body: Continue the local probe and expose the credential failure as warning or structured diagnostic context.

options.title: Approve Fail-Closed Status
options.body: Accept immediate local failure and require explicit fresh-install and upgrade evidence across all affected commands.

recommendation.title: Preserve Probe Behavior
recommendation.body: Continue the local probe and expose the credential failure as warning or structured diagnostic context.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest historical ownership across the exact gateway auth and status paths and authored major adjacent refactors.
